newsitem.title: USA: Carter to meet Chinese leaders for policy discussion.
newsitem.headline: Carter to meet Chinese leaders for policy discussion.

text.p: Former U.S. President Jimmy Carter will visit China this month to discuss its domestic and foreign policy with Chinese leaders, the Carter Centre said on Thursday.
Carter and a group including his wife Rosalynn and former U.S. Sen. Sam Nunn of Georgia was scheduled to travel to Beijing July 23-29 at the invitation of the Chinese Institute of Foreign Affairs.
"I'm looking forward to meeting with Chinese leaders and learning more about recent developments in the country's foreign and domestic policies," the former president said in a statement.
Carter has visited China three times since the United States established full diplomatic relations with the communist regime in Beijing during his administration.
